newsitem.title: USA: W.R. Carpenter issues $105 million in junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: W.R. Carpenter issues $105 million in junk bonds.

text.p: The following 144A debt issue from W.R. Carpenter North America Inc was priced on Thursday via CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Corp and BA Securities Inc, according to a high-yield syndicate source.
The issue was increased in size by $5 million.
W.R. Carpenter manufactures aerial and scissor lifts.
BORROWER W.R. CARPENTER NORTH AMERICA INC
TYPE SNR SUB NOTES ISS PRICE 99.542 FIRST PAY DATE 12/15/97 LAST MOODY'S B3 YIELD 10.70 PCT PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL
LAST S&P B-MINUS SPREAD 408 BPS CALLABLE NON CALL FIVE
NOTES: Three year equity call for 35 percent at 110.625.
